request.style: English, soul, deep male baritone solo with gospel choir, Hammond organ, upright bass, acoustic guitar, tambourine, warm and reflective mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
God listened to Leah
She conceived a fifth son
He said my wages are given
Because I gave my servant
So she named him Issachar
The name means reward

[Chorus]
Issachar is a strong-boned donkey
Lying down between the saddlebags
He saw that his resting place was good
And that the land was pleasant

[Verse]
He bent his shoulder to the load
And became a slave at forced labor
The sons are Tola and Puvah
Iob and Shimron are there
With Jacob they went to Egypt
To live with Joseph in the famine

[Chorus]
Issachar is a strong-boned donkey
Lying down between the saddlebags
He saw that his resting place was good
And that the land was pleasant

[Verse]
In the wilderness they counted them
Men twenty years old and up
Fit for service in the army
Listed by name and clan
The number from the tribe
Was fifty-four thousand four hundred

[Chorus]
Issachar is a strong-boned donkey
Lying down between the saddlebags
He saw that his resting place was good
And that the land was pleasant

[Bridge]
Moses spoke a blessing
Rejoice in your going out
And rejoice in your tents
Summon peoples to the mountain
Offer sacrifices of righteousness
Feast on the abundance of the seas

[Outro]
Treasures hidden in the sand
The wages of God
